subject.title: feat(setup): stream provider prepare progress to every surface

question: Should guided setup introduce a separate `openclaw.setup.prepare.start` RPC and a bundled `gemma4:e4b` recommendation, or should provider preparation progress remain within the existing setup/auth contract?
rationale: The patch adds a new privileged gateway API and a provider-specific multi-gigabyte recommendation; code review cannot choose that permanent product and compatibility boundary without owner intent.

options.title: Unify the existing setup path
options.body: Extend the existing activation/auth flow to stream provider progress and avoid a parallel RPC unless a concrete client contract proves it necessary.

options.title: Adopt the prepare RPC
options.body: Keep the new method, but wire every client, document the API and model policy, and provide live fresh-install, cancellation, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split transport from recommendation
options.body: Land generic wizard progress separately and review the Ollama fallback model, size copy, and consent flow in a focused follow-up.

recommendation.title: Unify the existing setup path
recommendation.body: Extend the existing activation/auth flow to stream provider progress and avoid a parallel RPC unless a concrete client contract proves it necessary.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available merged-history connection to the bundled Ollama setup and auth surface.
